title: Rename Model Schema Manifest To Document
description: Rename framework kernel and app terminology from model to document for schema manifests: ModelHandle/ModelId/ModelVersion/ModelDiff/ModelKind, ResourceKind::Model, model_projection/model_projection_schema, WIT migrate-model/read-model/write-model, and remaining play.model body keys (shooting).
summary:
Renamed framework kernel and plugin contract terminology from model to document for schema manifests.

Kernel types: ModelHandle/ModelId/ModelVersion/ModelDiff/ModelKind → Document*; ResourceKind::Model → Document; model_projection/model_projection_schema → document_projection/document_projection_schema; KernelOperation.model and OpEnvelope.model → document.

WIT: migrate-model/read-model/write-model → migrate-document/read-document/write-document; restored list-tools/window-engagements/window-measures exports that component.rs already implemented.

Updated framework plugin host, OS core, sync, wgpu renderer, and shooting plugin (play body key shooting.play.model → shooting.play.scene to avoid collision with shooting.play.document panel).

Fixed generated semio-framework-plugin.d.ts aliases (MigrateModel* → MigrateDocument*). Apps already used *_DOCUMENT_SCHEMA constants.

Tests: @semio-tech/framework-core (7), semio-framework-plugin (10), semio-framework-sync (1), semio-framework-os (included in plugin crate tests) — all passed.

Note: plugin-modules *_component.js still contain migrate-model until a full `bun nx run @semio-tech/framework-os-dev:plugin` rebuild completes (blocked by unrelated puzzle-plugin wasm build failure). CAD spatial Model/ModelDiff and program yields "model" left unchanged.
